question: Should OpenClaw replace the single memory slot with role-specific memory slots in core/plugin API, or keep memory composition outside core for now?
rationale: The request adds public config and plugin lifecycle/API surface, while VISION.md says memory currently has one active slot and config compatibility requires doctor-backed migrations for schema changes.

options.title: Review the role-slot PR
options.body: Use the open linked PR as the concrete design vehicle, requiring compatibility and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Keep one memory slot
options.body: Decline role-specific memory slots for now and document the supported plugin/workaround boundaries.

recommendation.title: Review the role-slot PR
recommendation.body: Use the open linked PR as the concrete design vehicle, requiring compatibility and upgrade proof before merge.
